info.name: Kurly Logistics Services (KLS) Open API Authentication 배송운영 정책 API

description.content:
Kurly Logistics Services (KLS) Open API lets contracted shipper clients (화주사) integrate their systems with Kurly's fulfillment (물류대행) and delivery-agency (배송대행) services. This document was reconstructed by API Evangelist from Kurly's own published API reference at https://developers.kurly.com — every path, method, summary and response status below is taken from that reference. Request/response schemas are rendered client-side on the provider's site and are NOT reproduced here; treat the referenced page (externalDocs) as authoritative for payloads.

 Email: logistics-dev@kurlycorp.com
